paragraphs: LegalEdge Software sells case management systems to city and county attorneys, prosecutors, public defenders, government agencies, school districts, and tribal governments across the United States. The software is web-based and is designed for the demands of government legal agencies, usable from a mainstream browser on a desktop, notebook or tablet.

The LegalEdge application handles case intake, document generation from templates, discovery management, time tracking and reporting. CityLaw NG and CountyLaw NG are built for city and county legal departments and hosted in Microsoft Azure or Microsoft Azure Government. Prosecutor Dialog organizes evidence, court dates, witnesses and legal documents for a prosecutor's caseload. A case-aware AI assistant called LEA summarizes police reports, claim files and transcripts and drafts first-pass motions, contracts and correspondence.

The current company combines LegalEdge Software, Judicial Dialog Systems and Cycom Data Systems, which merged into one team. Implementations span more than 150 jurisdictions nationwide, ranging in size up to 500 users.

quote.text: LegalEdge Software delivers a comprehensive ecosystem for modern judicial agencies to manage cases, automate workflows, and access critical data anytime, anywhere.
